repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR condition uses the second snapshot ($t2) minus the first ($t1), but the candidate reads the sensor again inside the `if` guard instead of using $t2. This causes the guard to compare the current live value against $t2, failing when the live value differs from the stored $t2. Evidence F2 shows the action was missing at the mismatch instant because the guard evaluated to false.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the live sensor read in the `if` condition with the stored variable $t2 to match the IR's logic of comparing two historical snapshots.
